label: 510(k) Admin Pack — Cover Letter + Administrative Summary
description: 510(k) cover letter for a Class II medical device premarket notification.

inputs.device_description: The NeuroSense Pro is a continuous electroencephalography (cEEG) monitoring system intended for use in hospital settings. It consists of a 32-channel amplifier, proprietary electrode headset, and software for real-time signal acquisition and display. The device incorporates machine learning-assisted artifact rejection and automated seizure detection alerting.
inputs.intended_use: The NeuroSense Pro is intended for the non-invasive recording, display, and storage of electroencephalographic (EEG) signals in adult and pediatric patients (≥2 years) in hospital settings. The device provides continuous monitoring with automated alerting to support clinical decision-making by qualified healthcare professionals.
inputs.substantial_equivalence: The NeuroSense Pro shares the same intended use and fundamental technology (scalp EEG acquisition and display) as the predicate device. Differences include: (1) increased channel count (32 vs. 25), (2) integrated ML-based artifact rejection, and (3) automated seizure detection alerts. Performance testing demonstrates substantially equivalent signal quality, and the additional features are well-characterized with clinical validation data included in this submission.
